passIndependence.limitation: Both passes were produced by 5.6 Sol in one active task. moves.sourceExcerpt: find out how much more and more there is to know in these circumstances which I believe to be undeniable the only respectable intellectual position is one of Doubt skepticism reservation and free and I'd stress free and unfettered inquiry in that lies as it has always Lain our only hope so you should beware always of those who say that these questions have already been decided in particular to those who tell you that they've been decided by reservation excuse me by Revelation uh that they there are handed

passA.rationale: The defense of open inquiry supplies a relevant skeptical standard, but calling it the only respectable position is broader than the excerpt establishes.

passB.rationale: The methodological warning is lucid and pertinent to revelation-based certainty, while its exclusivity and evidential support remain underargued.

passA.rationale: D'Souza meets the skeptical frame on its own terms and explicitly disclaims authority, but this passage promises a reason-based case rather than presenting it.

passB.rationale: The move is unusually responsive and charitable as a methodological commitment, though its evidential score is limited because the substantive argument has not yet arrived.
